in_sanskrit.name: Bra-Indra
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name 'Bratindra' is a combination of two Sanskrit words: 'Bra' and 'Indra'. 'Bra' is a short form of 'Brahma', the creator deity in Hinduism. 'Indra' is the king of gods and the ruler of the rain, storm, and thunder in Hindu mythology. Thus, the name 'Bratindra' signifies the association of the person with both Lord Brahma and Lord Indra.

in_hindi.name: Bratindra
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Universe
in_hindi.long_meaning: Bratindra एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Bratindra is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Brahma' meaning God or Supreme Being and 'Indra' meaning Lord of the Universe. This name signifies the divine power and supremacy of the deity. In Hindu mythology, Lord Indra is known as the king of the gods and the god of rain, thunder, and lightning. Naming a child Bratindra is believed to bestow upon them divine blessings and protection.
